newsitem.title: USA: Riser says holders accept Class B tender.
newsitem.headline: Riser says holders accept Class B tender.

text.p: Riser Foods Inc shareholders agreed to tender all outstanding Class B common stock to privately-held Giant Eagle Inc for $42 per share, Riser and Giant Eagle said Wednesday.
Riser stock closed at 41-7/8 on Tuesday. Giant Eagle's previously announced offer to tender Class A shares for $42 will expire on June 17.

The Riser Class B common stock is tendered to Talon Acquisition Co, a wholly-owned Giant Eagle subsidiary, the companies said in a statement. Talon earlier had made a cash tender offer on May 14 to buy all outstanding Class A common stock for $42 per share, a spokewoman said.
